title: Icelandic Local Functionality Overview
summary: Iceland local functionality for Business Central includes VAT reporting, electronic invoicing, chart of accounts mapping, and deletion of posted invoices with Icelandic localization available from version 24.0.
features: Icelandic localization based on W1 Base App
Print VAT Summary Information on Documents
Special Data Output and Reports for the Tax Authority
Map IRS Numbers to the Chart of Accounts
Deleting Posted Invoices and Credit Memos
